not_implemented_or_not_established: Reviewer independence is DECLARED, never established: a draft may only carry UNESTABLISHED identity, and the host assembles real separation from execution facts. Renaming a model or restarting a process is not independence and nothing here can detect that it was attempted.

The blind-isolation check covers the fixed Task input families only. What an interpreter actually read at run time, and whether a code comment or file name leaked the expected answer, are not checked.
No review outcome value (SUPPORTED, ALIGNED, KERNEL_CHECKED, admission) is produced or validated for correctness; only the draft shape is checked.
No model execution, scheduling, record persistence or identity authentication. Draft shape validity is not record-set validity and not scientific correctness.
No RecordSet closure, stored envelope or hash verification; business root-level if/then gates are inherited only where this checker re-implements them.
This module has no worked example directory; its conformance fixtures are synthetic teaching material with placeholder references, not real records.
